# Rehan Quant Lab (RQL)
> Sovereign Pure-Rust Desktop Computing. Air-Gapped Execution, Zero Cloud Telemetry, Lifetime Perpetual Ownership.

Rehan Quant Lab (founded by Mohammad Rehan, Systems Architect in Patna, Bihar, India) engineers high-performance, single-binary Windows desktop software for commercial enterprises, retail operators, legal chambers, chartered accountants, and quant institutions. Every application runs 100% offline with zero cloud dependencies, zero telemetry, and zero recurring SaaS subscriptions.

## Core Navigation & Official Endpoints
- [Official Portal](https://rehanquantlab.com/): Master executive portal and system overview.
- [Commercial Store](https://rehanquantlab.com/store.html): The complete catalog of 28 Commercial Desktop Workstations with direct Gumroad perpetual license acquisition.
- [Systems Portfolio](https://rehanquantlab.com/projects.html): Production software architecture, performance metrics, and quantitative research.
- [Security Architecture](https://rehanquantlab.com/security.html): Air-gapped compliance, SHA-256 binary provenance, HIPAA/GDPR/DPDP compliance documentation.
- [RQL Aegis Platform](https://rehanquantlab.com/aegis.html): Enterprise deterministic state kernel and cryptographic ledger framework.
- [Career & Technical Dossier](https://rehanquantlab.com/experience.html): Founder background, engineering milestones, and technical certifications.

## Technical Guarantees & Architectural Specs
- **Runtime Environment**: 100% Native 64-bit Windows portable binaries (.exe) and Microsoft Windows Installer packages.
- **Dependencies**: Zero Python, zero Node.js, zero Java runtime dependencies. Pure compiled Rust native binaries.
- **Data Privacy**: Air-gapped execution. Outbound socket creation is physically excluded from core logic. No cloud telemetry, no analytics beacons, no external pingbacks.
- **Licensing Model**: Perpetual binary ownership. One-time purchase via Gumroad. Zero monthly subscriptions or recurring fees.
- **Cryptographic Provenance**: Every release is paired with official SHA-256 hashes and digital authenticity certificates.
